## How to read this page

Each box is one check. The first word is the state: **OK**, **Warning**, **Problem**, or a grey **Not enough data** / **Not set up yet**. The rest says what it means and the first thing to do. Colour is only a help; the word always comes first.

- **Local** is the answer service on this Mac. **QA** shows *Not set up yet* until the QA service is deployed.
- A grey *No information yet* means the dashboard has no data for that box. Run `./scripts/init.sh --monitoring-status`.
- This page runs only on this Mac while Docker Desktop is open. It does not send alerts.

0.text: OK. The answer service is running and ready to answer. Nothing to do.

1.text: Warning. The answer service works now, but it was down or not ready at some point in the last 5 minutes. First thing to do: wait a few minutes and look again. Run ./scripts/init.sh --local-rag-service-status (or ./scripts/init.sh --container-status if you use the container).

2.text: Problem. The dashboard cannot reach the answer service, so nobody can ask questions. First thing to do: run ./scripts/init.sh --local-rag-start (or ./scripts/init.sh --container-start).

3.text: Problem. The answer service is running but not ready to answer. First thing to do: run ./scripts/init.sh --local-rag-service-status (or ./scripts/init.sh --container-status if you use the container).

4.text: Not set up yet. This environment has no running service for the dashboard to watch. Nothing to do until the QA service is deployed.

result.text: No information yet. The dashboard has not received data for this check. First thing to do: wait one minute, then run ./scripts/init.sh --monitoring-status.
